issue.title: test_enter_loads_raw_definition_and_binds_source fails under the full parallel lane: NoMatches on #frontmatter-raw
issue.description:
PROPOSED BY phase bead sase-p8.4 (epic sase-p8, 'sase pipe'), routed here by that epic's land agent. Unrelated to that epic's diff, which added a CLI hand-off command and touched no ACE/Textual code.

REPRODUCTION: failed once under sase-p8.4's escalated full parallel run (~32,685 tests) on 2026-08-18 with a NoMatches lookup failure for the '#frontmatter-raw' widget, and passed when rerun in isolation. Two other nodes failed in the same run and are tracked separately: test_ace_page_fast_startup_is_structurally_quiet (sase-oz, +1 recorded there) and test_cache_miss_shows_loading_then_worker_result (filed alongside this bead).

WHY ITS OWN BEAD: sase-ct ('Flaky ACE TUI tests under full parallel just test run') is a RETIRED umbrella whose close reason forbids +1, and its retirement policy directs each observation to a node-specific bead named for the failing node. This is that bead for this node.

WHAT A WORKER NEEDS: NoMatches on a query for '#frontmatter-raw' means the test queried the widget before the pane had mounted it, so the likely defect is a missing await/settle point in the test rather than a product bug — under contention the mount lands after the query instead of before. Confirm by instrumenting where the widget is mounted relative to the enter action, then replace the bare query with an explicit wait for the mounted state. Record which lanes do NOT reproduce it, as sase-oz did.

RELATED: sase-j7 — in-progress epic 'Fix the sase-ct flake class at its root - process-global state leaking between tests' is the structural fix for this class; this node may be subsumed by it.
